primary_claim: A LLaMa-3.1-8B model fine-tuned (SFT+DPO) to make its values explicit via inline value tags ('WiseLLaMa-8B') produces responses that crowd-workers rate as more legible, likable, and predictable than the default instruction-tuned model, with 77% of participants agreeing responses adhered to the stated values and 94% able to correctly predict which of 3 responses came from the values-trained model

effect.metric: % crowd-workers agreeing/predicting on value legibility, likability, and predictability (n=78 participants)
effect.value: 77% agreed responses adhered to stated values; 67% found values good/relevant; 85% found responses less 'preachy' than baseline/naive-wise models; 94% correctly predicted which response came from the values-trained model; 74% reported increased trust

contradicts_or_qualifies: Argues current approaches used by ChatGPT (detailed rulebook compliance) and Claude (vague single-word values like 'curiosity'/'helpfulness') are inadequate compared to explicit, structured, value-legible training
stated_future_work: Train a larger model, e.g. DPO on Llama-405B
Train a model to search using values
Train a model to negotiate using values
Build integrity evals covering multi-agent cooperation, value-reliability, and transforming harmful requests
Use sparse autoencoders and attribution/logit-attribution patching to interpret internalized values mechanistically
limitations_stated: Training data only consists of one- or two-turn conversations, so the model sometimes infers too much from a user's initial message rather than asking follow-up questions
Synthetic data generation had to fight the base models' tendency toward lecturing, refusal, and superficial harmlessness framing, likely degrading data quality
The prompt chain currently generates values overly focused on introspection/coaching and overuses certain phrases or activity suggestions
Findings are not conclusive evidence that the approach produces deep integrity across all layers of the model's decision-making
quote: 77% of participants agreed that the model's responses adhered well to these values.
